issue_request: FHIR-17977 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ExplanationOfBenefit change request for STU3 asking the Scope and Usage text to be expanded to include the scope of claim, preauthorization, and predetermination use.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in the active ExplanationOfBenefit narrative. additional_context: ExplanationOfBenefit is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/explanationofbenefit/explanationofbenefit-introduction.xml is the authoritative resource narrative by convention for that resource folder. Later spelling/editorial commits adjusted wording such as payer/payor but preserved the claim, predetermination, and preauthorization scope. Searches of Zulip and Confluence found no discussion or minutes conflicting with the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. An empty audit commit was published because the current active EOB Scope and Usage text already conveys the requested claim, preauthorization, and predetermination scope.
